resources.string: The names the console folders get at the destination. Pick another system\'s names to fill a card for that system.
You pick the folder next. The console folders get the names chosen under Folder names.
The console folders keep the names they have here.
Short names like gba, snes, megadrive, psx. Pick ES-DE\'s ROMs folder.
Batocera 42 or newer, inside roms (gamecube, megacd, wswan, lynx…). Pick the card or its roms folder.
Inside roms, with Knulli\'s own names (segacd, o2em…). Pick the card or its roms folder.
Straight on the EASYROMS card (gba, gc, coleco, pokemonmini…). Pick the card.
Inside roms on the games card (gamecube, sgfx, neocd…). Pick the card or its roms folder.
Inside Roms, in capitals (GBA, SFC, FC, MD, PS…). Pick the card or its Roms folder.
Inside ROMS, names muOS gives a core by itself (gba, snes, psx…). Pick the card or its ROMS folder.
This only sets the folder names. The other system may still want its own game lists, BIOS files and emulator cores.
